title: 'Kimi to Hanabi to Yakusoku to' Reveals Additional Cast, Staff, Theme Song, First Trailer
content: The official website for the anime movie adaptation of Kaori Mado and Akamoku 's Kimi to Hanabi to Yakusoku to ( You, Fireworks, and Our Promise ) light novel revealed additional cast, staff, the theme song, a key visual (pictured), and the first trailer on Tuesday.

title: Scooby-Doo! Anime by The Apothecary Diaries, Pokemon Studio OLM Heads to Tubi & Cartoon Network
content: Variety reports that a new anime based on the iconic Scooby-Doo! IP, Yokoso Scooby-Doo! ( Welcome, Scooby-Doo! ), will be produced by Warner Bros. Animation, with OLM ( The Apothecary Diaries (co-produced with Toho Animation Studio), Pokémon ) handling animation.
author: Anime Corner

title: PlayStation Plus Service Raises Prices for New Customers in Select Regions
content: Sony announced on the official X (formerly Twitter ) account for the PlayStation console on Monday that it is increasing the monthly subscription price of its PlayStation Plus online gaming subscription service for new customers in select regions beginning on Wednesday.
author: ANN

title: 4 Years Later, My Hero Academia Shuts Down Major Project After Anime Finale
content: Four years after it began and after the TV anime series ended its run, My Hero Academia has shut down one of its biggest projects. My Hero Academia is currently in a great year as the anime is now in the midst of celebrating its 10th anniversary.
author: ComicBook

title: Deadline: David Derrick Jr., John Aoshima to Direct Live-Action/Animated Hybrid Hello Kitty Film
content: Entertainment news website Deadline reported on Monday that David Derrick Jr. ( Moana 2 ) and John Aoshima ( Ultraman: Rising ) are co-directing Warner Brothers and New Line Cinema 's planned live-action/animation hybrid film of Sanrio 's Hello Kitty character.
author: ANN

title: Cloverway Founder Yasuo Matsuo Launches New Global Production Studio IP Bay
content: Founder of former U.S.-based licensing agency Cloverway Yasuo Matsuo has launched IP Bay, a new global studio that is focused on producing adaptations of Japanese literature. The studio maintains offices in Hyogo, Tokyo, New York, and Los Angeles.
author: ANN

title: Demon Slayer: Infinity Castle to Get Limited Return to Theaters Ahead of Part 2
content: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba Infinity Castle is planning a limited return to theaters later this Summer, but only a few fans will be able to check it out. It’s no mystery how big of a success that Demon Slayer has been in theaters thus far.
